import sys
import os
import re
import optparse
import signal
import logging
import logging.handlers
import time
from logging.handlers import RotatingFileHandler
import pwd
from abc import abstractmethod
try:
    import commands
except ImportError:
    import subprocess as commands
SYS_USER = pwd.getpwuid(os.getuid()).pw_name
VERSION = 1.0
SOURCE_ENV = "source /etc/profile 2>/dev/null && source /home/%s/.bashrc && source /home/%s/gauss_env_file && env" % (
